label: TP
reason: User input from request parameter 'BlCurated00069' flows directly into an HTML attribute ('data-name') via replace("\"", """). This escapes double quotes but does not encode other dangerous characters like < > & which allows script tags (e.g., <script>) to bypass the filter and execute XSS.

evidence.note: The vulnerable line where user input is concatenated into an HTML attribute without full sanitization against all XSS vectors.
